sec: sec:D004: Third-party testing of tool calls

blocks.id: blk:D004: Third-party testing of tool calls/1
blocks.text: Appoint expert third-parties to evaluate tool calls in AI systems, including executing unauthorized actions, accessing restricted information, or making decisions beyond their intended scope at least every 3 months.
